textual.potential_relevance: A promised game-currency reward and iTunes gift card are presented together with the claimed condition that it is not a hack, which may require later context assessment of how the reward is obtained.
textual.limitations: The title alone does not establish whether any reward is delivered, whether any game rule is bypassed, or whether the claimed method is legitimate.

textual.observation: The description asks viewers to use an AppBounty URL and promotion code, saying the code gives the viewer 50 points and gives the speaker more points toward gift cards for viewers.

textual.limitations: The source records do not verify the website, the referral program, the point value, or whether gift cards are actually provided.
